signatures: public trait Eq<Rhs> { +def equals.(borrow rhs: Rhs) -> Bool throws Never effects {}; }
responsibility: Strong equality evidence for Self and Rhs; equals borrows its implicit Self receiver and explicit rhs, is pure, deterministic, synchronous, non-consuming and total, and one witness derives both == and !=
notes: Eq requires reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity. BinaryNotEqual is logical negation of the exact BinaryEqual Eq.equals result and owns no independent conformance. NaN-like partial equality uses an intrinsic or separately named partial profile rather than weakening Eq.
